question: A ladder is leaning against a wall makes an angle 'x' with the horizontal ground such that tanx = 192/80 If the length of the ladder is 52 metres, then what is the distance (in metres) of the foot of the ladder from the wall?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplified ratio tan x = 192 ÷ 80 = 12 / 5 (Perpendicular / Base).

Using Pythagorean triplet (5, 12, 13), Hypotenuse = 13 units.

Ladder length (hypotenuse) = 13 units = 52 m.

Scale factor (1 unit) = 52 ÷ 13 = 4 m.

Distance of foot from wall (base) = 5 units × 4 = 20 m.

**∴ Answer = 20 metres**
